Beginner.learningGoal: Write small extension methods that make calling code read better.
gotchas: Extension methods can't access private members
An extension on object pollutes IntelliSense everywhere
Extensions are resolved at compile time, not virtually
goodSolutionShows: Clear names that read naturally at the call site

Intermediate.learningGoal: Design extension APIs: fluent builders, generic extensions and discoverability.
gotchas: Extension on an interface vs on concrete types
Generic extensions that box value types
Namespaces control where extensions are visible
goodSolutionShows: Fluent extension chains that return the builder
Extensions grouped in a sensible static class/namespace

Expert.learningGoal: Use extension members (C# 14 extension blocks) and know the resolution rules.
gotchas: Instance member wins over an extension with the same signature
Extension properties have no backing storage
goodSolutionShows: Static extension members where they read better
No conflicts with existing instance members
shapeHints: extension properties on IEnumerable<T> such as IsEmpty
static factory extensions on a type you don't own
